crossRefs.note: He took Elijah’s mantle that fell from him, and struck the waters, and said, “Where is Yahweh, the God of Elijah?” When…

He went out to the spring of the waters, and threw salt into it, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘I have healed these waters.…
He looked behind him and saw them, and cursed them in Yahweh’s name. Then two female bears came out of the woods, and…
Samuel grew, and Yahweh was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.
He went from there to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned to Samaria.
It was so, when Elisha the man of God heard that the king of Israel had torn his clothes, that he sent to the king…
So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariots, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.

parallels.note: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for Yahweh’s word.”

people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jehoshaphat
people.line: Son of Asa, king of Judah.

translations.web: Jehoshaphat said, “Yahweh’s word is with him.” So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
translations.bsb: Jehoshaphat affirmed, “The word of the LORD is with him.” So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
translations.kjv: And Jehoshaphat said, The word of the LORD is with him. So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
translations.asv: And Jehoshaphat said, The word of Jehovah is with him. So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
